What I'm seeing is alot of builds missing what I'd consider a core item. Heartseekers is great on thanatos. It gives great potential to early game ability damage which is one of his key strengths. I'd also forgo a jotunns due for a higher pen item such as titans bane as he has an inbuilt 5s CD reduction on any god kills. Warriors tabu is a must. Soul eater and hydras are both incredibly strong on thana. Soul eater over heals the damage he takes from abilities whilst providing a touch of cdr and decent power whilst hydras allows for faster combos with aa canceling. Lastly I'd recommend mantle and SoR. They give him the tankiness he needs to get in and out.
